modules.title: 推理结论仍要由外部结果核对

items.title: 适合多步问题
items.text: 额外推理计算可帮助拆解较难任务或安排检查步骤，但也可能增加 token 用量和等待，实际影响随模型与任务变化。

items.title: 要求可核验的证据
items.text: 看检查顺序、工具结果或测试记录；一段看似完整的解释不能代替实际请求和保存结果。

modules.title: 等待更久不等于推理正确
modules.text: 推理模型仍可能给出错误结论。原始推理 token 通常不会以完整私有思维文本形式显示；验收应依赖外部可检查结果。

lessonPractice.title: 报名页面显示提交成功，刷新却找不到记录。Agent 按步骤改过代码后，哪项证据最能确认问题已解决？

options.label: 重新提交并刷新页面，确认请求成功且记录仍能读到
options.feedback: 对。真实请求结果和刷新后的记录能检查保存链路是否完成，模型对原因的解释不能代替这项验证。

options.label: 接受 Agent 对根因的解释，并查看它是否改了相关代码
options.feedback: 解释和代码改动说明 Agent 做过尝试，但还没有证明请求成功或数据保存后可读。

options.label: 让 Agent 展示更长的内部思考，确认分析过程够完整
options.feedback: 原始内部推理不是可靠验收证据；应查看真实请求结果和刷新后的记录。

en.title: A signup page says the submission succeeded, but the record is missing after refresh. After the Agent changes the code, what best confirms the issue is fixed?

options.label: Submit again, refresh, and confirm the request succeeds and the record is still available
options.feedback: Correct. The real request result and the record after refresh check whether the save path completed; the model's explanation cannot replace them.

options.label: Accept the Agent's root-cause explanation and check whether it edited related code
options.feedback: An explanation and code change show an attempt, but do not prove the request succeeded or that saved data can be read.

options.label: Ask the Agent to reveal longer internal reasoning to confirm its analysis was complete
options.feedback: Raw internal reasoning is not reliable acceptance evidence; inspect the actual request result and the record after refresh.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这个报名问题涉及提交和刷新后的读取。请先列出检查顺序，用实际请求结果和保存记录找原因；改完后重新提交并刷新，只有记录仍在时才告诉我修好了。请说明结论依据，不用展示内部思维。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: This signup issue involves submission and reading the result after refresh. First give me the investigation order, then use the actual request result and saved record to find the cause. After the change, submit again and refresh; say it is fixed only if the record remains. Show the evidence for your conclusion, not internal reasoning.

learning.assumes: You have seen AI take longer on a complex task, or heard of reasoning models.
learning.outcome: You can use a reasoning model for a multi-step task and check its conclusion against logs, tool results, or the actual outcome.

modules.title: Verify a reasoning model's conclusion against external results

items.title: Useful for multi-step tasks
items.text: Additional reasoning compute can help break down a difficult task or plan checks. It can also add token use and waiting; effects vary by model and task.

items.title: Ask for checkable evidence
items.text: Look at the investigation order, tool results, or test records. A detailed explanation does not replace the actual request and saved result.

modules.title: A longer wait does not prove correct reasoning
modules.text: Reasoning models can still be wrong. Raw reasoning tokens generally are not shown as full private thought text; acceptance should rely on externally checkable results.

distinctions.label: Temperature
distinctions.text: Temperature adjusts sampling randomness for APIs that support it; a reasoning model uses additional computation on complex tasks. They are different controls.

distinctions.label: Showing a thought process
distinctions.text: Explanatory text on screen is not the model's real internal reasoning. Raw reasoning tokens are generally not shown as private thought text; a checkable conclusion, evidence, and steps are more useful.
